game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep salt bags safe from icicle bats.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep salt bags safe from icicle bats. Each round, a new salt bags challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of salt bags by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Furrier Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Furrier Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
